<p class="role">Principal Investigator</p>

### Annie Nigra, ScM, PhD

[Annie Nigra](https://www.publichealth.columbia.edu/profile/anne-annie-nigra-phd), ScM, PhD, is an environmental epidemiologist and Assistant Professor in the [Department of Epidemiology](https://geiselmed.dartmouth.edu/epidemiology/) in the [Geisel School of Medicine at Dartmouth College](https://geiselmed.dartmouth.edu/). In addition to leading the WATER EPI Lab, Annie is the Director of the [EARTH Program](https://www.publichealth.columbia.edu/academics/departments/environmental-health-sciences/programs/non-degree-offerings/earth-program) and is engaged with several large research centers.
:::
